complexity_ledger.narrative: CD-01 ships the complexity DESCRIPTOR and removes the suggested-move machinery. Validation project 1 proved the ABSTRACT/DECOMPOSE/REFACTOR chooser confidently wrong on standard TLA+: with `INVARIANT Inv` and `Inv == RealInv` (a one-token alias body, exactly what the scaffold ships), the scanner judged every variable "read by no invariant" and recommended projecting away ALL variables (results/f1_regression.txt, PRE-FIX section). What changed (scripts and docs only, zero TLA delta): (1) suggest_move, OrdinalChain, latching_booleans, implication_chains, projected_bound and the Advisory.recommendation field were removed; the report and JSON now carry only [MEASURED] facts -- dimension table, bound + dominant dimensions, R/W matrix, modularity + clusters + port-crossing actions, dense rows/columns (god-state), invariant coverage, justification linkage, TLC diagnostics, and advisory threshold-breach warnings that state the fact without recommending. (2) F1: resolve_definition_body() expands cfg-named invariants through aliasing/composition transitively (cycle-guarded). Regression tests fail pre-fix (results/f1_regression.txt). (3) F3: the domain source is TypeInvariant, then TypeOK, then the transitively resolved cfg invariants; with no resolvable domain the bound is None, rendered "UNKNOWN" with an explicit warning -- never a silent 1 (results/f3_bound.txt). complexity_ledger.render_report renders the None bound as "unknown". (4) Exit semantics unchanged: exit 0 on any analyzable model; nonzero only for an unanalyzable hierarchy (MF-030 fail-closed). Advisory, never blocking (MF-036) is preserved. (5) Docs: SKILL.md, references/architecture_tractability.md and references/modular_fuzzing.md now present the descriptor as the shipped surface; the three moves remain as the owner's design vocabulary, no longer as scanner output. Retention oracles (kill_rate/effect_conformance/external_coverage) were not re-run: the model is byte-identical to the baseline, behavior retention is witnessed by the identical TLC run (5,619,356 generated / 231,621 distinct / depth 25, 46.3% of max_distinct_states 500000), and no complexity decrease is claimed that would require them. Per the epic's case_execution_rule the fuzzing machinery is experimental and not ticket validation.

refinement.detail: Zero-delta ticket. CD-01 is a scripts-and-docs change (analyze_complexity.py, tests, SKILL.md, references) that removes the suggested-move machinery and fixes two measurement-honesty defects (F1 invariant-alias resolution, F3 explicit-unknown bound). The TLA+ model is byte-identical to the epic baseline and TLC reports the same 231,621 distinct states / depth 25 / bound 699,840 (results/tlc_current.txt). The refinement search for an architectural reduction found none applicable: the ticket's objective was to make the scanner's OUTPUT honest (facts, not judgment), not to change the model. The F1 fix makes the invariant-coverage fact correct on standard TLA+ (aliased/composed invariants); the F3 fix stops the bound from silently collapsing to 1 -- both improve measurement accuracy without changing this model's own figures.

ticket.objective: Remove the suggested-move machinery (abstract/decompose/refactor recommendations) from the complexity scanner and ship a factual complexity DESCRIPTOR: per-variable dimension table, state-space bound + dominant dimensions, variables x actions R/W matrix, graph-modularity + near-decomposable clusters, dense-row/god-state detection, per-variable domains. Facts, not judgment. Fix F1: projectable_variables reads only the immediate body of the cfg-named invariant, so INVARIANT Inv with Inv == ExternalInvariant (a one-token alias) makes every variable "read by no invariant" and the scanner recommends projecting away ALL variables (analyze_complexity.py ~1038 / ~793) — resolve invariant aliasing/composition transitively. Fix F3: the state-space bound silently degenerates to 1 without a TypeInvariant/TypeOK — make it meaningful (resolve domains from the cfg or scaffolded TypeOK) or report it explicitly unknown, never a silent 1. Advisory, never blocking (already true; keep it). Update SKILL.md and references so the descriptor is the shipped surface and no suggested-move claims remain. Suggestions may return in a later epic, earned from real-app observations — not in this one.
